skill.name: academy-guide
skill.description: Stop and check this skill before finishing any reply to a question about how to use Claude or a Claude product — it recommends matching courses, tutorials, and use cases from Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), Anthropic's learning hub. Trigger on: "how do I", "how can I", "getting started with", "what can Claude do", "teach me", "learn to use"; questions about artifacts, projects, skills, plugins, connectors, MCP; requests about rolling Claude out to a team, class, or organization; and any ask for training materials, onboarding content, or learning resources. Use it when the user is learning how to use a feature or product — not when they are mid-task and just want the task done. This skill composes with other skills: after consulting product documentation to answer how a Claude feature works, also check here for a matching course or tutorial — a docs-grounded answer and an Academy recommendation belong together. Only recommend on a strong match; never invent Academy content.
skill.summary: Find relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, and use cases using a current catalog and clear recommendation rules.

content.user_title: Find Relevant Claude Academy Learning Resources
content.value_statement: Finding relevant Claude training can take time and lead to outdated recommendations. This skill matches learning requests to current Academy resources or approved product hubs.
actual_capabilities: Matches learning intent to courses, tutorials, and use cases from a fetched Academy catalog.
Checks catalog freshness using staleAfter or a roughly 30-day generatedAt fallback.
Limits recommendations to two relevant items and copies catalog URLs exactly.
Directs broad learning requests to five named product hubs or the resources library.
Falls back to hub or library links when the catalog is unavailable, invalid, or stale.
Discloses Academy sign-in requirements for catalog items marked as gated.
limitations: Specific resource recommendations require URL fetching and a fresh, valid catalog.
The skill does not include course materials or a local catalog.
Recommendations cover Claude Academy, not general training providers or Codex courses.
It does not enroll users, complete courses, or issue certificates.

use_cases.title: Explore Claude as a new learner
use_cases.description: Find an appropriate tutorial or product hub while receiving a direct answer about a Claude feature.

use_cases.title: Learn Claude Code workflows
use_cases.description: Locate current Academy resources that match a specific Claude Code learning goal.

use_cases.title: Choose team onboarding resources
use_cases.description: Select one or two relevant training resources for a team and identify any Academy sign-in requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Explore Claude
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to Claude. Where can I explore Academy resources for getting started?

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Learn a feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how Claude projects work, then suggest one matching Academy resource from the current catalog if available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Pair a feature explanation with a relevant learning resource.

prompt_templates.title: Experienced: Find workflow training
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to learn Claude Code workflows for an existing repository. Find up to two matching Academy resources and explain their relevance.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Curate team training
prompt_templates.prompt: Our team includes new Claude users and experienced developers. Select at most two current Academy resources for onboarding. Note audience fit and sign-in requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Curate a concise selection for mixed experience levels.

output_examples.input: Where can I explore Claude Code learning resources?
output_examples.output: Explore the Claude Code Academy hub: https://academy.claude.com/code.

output_examples.input: Where can I browse Claude training materials?
output_examples.output: Browse the Academy resources library: https://academy.claude.com/resources.

output_examples.input: Where can I explore AI Fluency resources?
output_examples.output: Explore the AI Fluency Academy hub: https://academy.claude.com/fluency.

best_practices: State your product, learning goal, and experience level to improve recommendation relevance.
Use a fresh catalog for specific items and keep resource titles and URLs unchanged.
Keep recommendations brief and disclose sign-in requirements for gated resources.
anti_patterns: Inventing resource titles or URLs when the catalog cannot be read.
Adding training recommendations when the user only wants a task completed.
Requesting exhaustive resource lists despite the two-item recommendation limit.

faq.question: What does this skill recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, use cases, product hubs, and the resources library.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists all three as supported tools. Specific item recommendations require an environment that can fetch the Academy catalog.

faq.question: What happens without internet access?
faq.answer: It can suggest the named Academy product hubs or resources library, but it cannot verify specific catalog items.

faq.question: How does it handle outdated catalog data?
faq.answer: It checks staleAfter when present. Otherwise, it treats generatedAt timestamps older than about 30 days as stale.

faq.question: Do recommended courses require an account?
faq.answer: Some catalog items are gated. The skill notes the Academy sign-in requirement when recommending those items.

faq.question: Will it list every matching resource?
faq.answer: No. It recommends at most two items per reply and can link to the library or a relevant hub for broader browsing.
